CustomField.description: Evaluates to number of days before opportunity create date based on response date. Same day is 0, after opportunity create is blank.
CustomField.formula: IF( Opportunity__r.CreatedDate - Response_Date__c >= 0, Opportunity__r.CreatedDate - Response_Date__c, NULL)
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Evaluates to number of days before opportunity create date based on response date. Same day is 0, after opportunity create is blank.
CustomField.label: Days Before Opportunity Create
